timeline.summary: On April 30, 2026, Polyplex Corporation completed the acquisition of a 51% stake in TechNova Printrite Products Private Limited for ₹62.10 crores.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,870.72 Cr (+7.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹24.8 Cr (+145.3% YoY).
Polyplex Corporation Limited’s Board of Directors, led by Ashok Kumar Gurnani, recommended ₹1 final dividend per ₹10 equity share for FY2025-26, payable post-AGM approval.
On May 27, 2026, Polyplex Corporation reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,868 Cr (+8% YoY) and normalized EBITDA of ₹128 Cr (+31% YoY).
Sanjiv Saraf declared no new encumbrances on Polyplex Corporation shares for promoter group as of March 31, 2025, filed April 3, 2026.
